annotations.title: What the agent may hand out

description: Your person's full name, email, and address, as the agent gives them to a venue: the name for bookings, the email for confirmations and payment links (never their mobile), the address only when a task needs it. Pass fields to set them; nothing to read. Ask your person before setting these.

address.description: Street address, for deliveries or service calls.

email.description: For confirmations, receipts and payment links.

full_name.description: As it should appear on a booking.

notes.description: Anything the agent should know when speaking for them (allergies to mention, preferred table, parking).

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. America/Denver, for calendar entries.
